mapper.select: SELECT watchlist_id AS watchlistId, account_id AS accountId, name AS name, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM watchlist WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY watchlist_id ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT watchlist_id AS watchlistId, account_id AS accountId, name AS name, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM watchlist WHERE account_id = #{accountId} ORDER BY watchlist_id ASC

SELECT watchlist_id AS watchlistId, account_id AS accountId, name AS name, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM watchlist WHERE watchlist_id = #{watchlistId} AND account_id = #{accountId}
SELECT watchlist_id AS watchlistId, account_id AS accountId, name AS name, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM watchlist WHERE account_id = #{accountId} AND name = #{name}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO watchlist (account_id, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{accountId}, now(), now())
INSERT INTO watchlist (account_id, name, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{accountId}, #{name}, now(), now())
mapper.select: SELECT watchlist_instrument_id AS watchlistInstrumentId, watchlist_id AS watchlistId, instrument_id AS instrumentId, added_at AS addedAt FROM watchlist_instrument WHERE watchlist_id = #{watchlistId} ORDER BY added_at DESC

SELECT wi.watchlist_instrument_id AS watchlistInstrumentId, wi.watchlist_id AS watchlistId, wi.instrument_id AS instrumentId, wi.added_at AS addedAt FROM watchlist_instrument wi JOIN watchlist w ON w.watchlist_id = wi.watchlist_id WHERE wi.watchlist_instrument_id = #{watchlistInstrumentId} AND w.account_id = #{accountId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO watchlist_instrument (watchlist_id, instrument_id, added_at) VALUES (#{watchlistId}, #{instrumentId}, now())
mapper.select: SELECT quote_id AS quoteId, instrument_id AS instrumentId, symbol, current_price AS currentPrice, currency, bid, ask, change, change_percent AS changePercent, last_updated AS lastUpdated, stale FROM instrument_quote WHERE instrument_id = #{instrumentId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO instrument_quote (instrument_id, symbol, current_price, currency, bid, ask, change, change_percent, last_updated, stale) VALUES (#{instrumentId}, #{symbol}, #{currentPrice}, #{currency}, #{bid}, #{ask}, #{change}, #{changePercent}, now(), #{stale}) ON CONFLICT (instrument_id) DO UPDATE SET current_price = EXCLUDED.current_price, currency = EXCLUDED.currency, bid = EXCLUDED.bid, ask = EXCLUDED.ask, change = EXCLUDED.change, change_percent = EXCLUDED.change_percent, last_updated = EXCLUDED.last_updated, stale = EXCLUDED.stale
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT instrument_id FROM watchlist_instrument ORDER BY instrument_id
